why_ai: AI app generation directly substitutes drag-and-drop building, with no licence or relationship moat.
why_clarity: An app either works or fails, though each build differs.
why_digital: Software built and sold online, used entirely on screen.

why_ai: Demand for governing generated apps grows with AI, though the solution itself is software.
why_clarity: Provenance is recordable, but what counts as maintainable ownership is loosely defined.
why_digital: App definitions and logs in, governance records out, entirely software.

why_ai: Generating a connector from an API specification is exactly what code models do.
why_clarity: A connector works against the API or it does not, testable instantly.
why_digital: API specs in, working connectors out.

why_ai: App structure and error history let AI answer usage questions and diagnose failures.
why_clarity: Support questions recur, though diagnosing each failure varies.
why_digital: Apps, logs and questions handled on screen.

why_ai: Every execution is logged and drift has signatures, so detection is automated monitoring.
why_clarity: A connector call succeeds or fails, observable on every run.
why_digital: Execution logs in, drift alerts and fixes out.

why_ai: Machine-readable app definitions let AI document and explain apps for new owners.
why_clarity: Changes can be tested against app behaviour, though every inherited app differs.
why_digital: App definitions in, documentation and safe changes out.

why_ai: API specifications and traffic describe what connectors need, which AI builds and maintains.
why_clarity: Connections are testable and repeat across thousands of systems.
why_digital: APIs in, integrations out, sold online.

why_ai: Usage and dependency evidence sits in the platform for software to score criticality.
why_clarity: Criticality is a judgment confirmed only when a builder leaves and something breaks.
why_digital: Usage and dependency data in, risk flags out.

why_ai: Mining customer apps is AI work, but the customer-built process corpus exists nowhere else.
why_clarity: Product value from the corpus is undefined and varies by use.
why_digital: Structured app definitions in, process insight products out.

why_ai: Discovery from network, billing and identity data is automated security tooling with compliance stakes.
why_clarity: An inventory list is exact, though completeness is hard to prove.
why_digital: Network, billing and identity data in, app inventory out.

why_ai: The spreadsheet describes the process, so AI can generate the app directly.
why_clarity: Migrated apps can be checked against the spreadsheet's existing behaviour.
why_digital: Spreadsheets and emails in, working applications out.
